title: 第22章 孩子静悄悄，必定在作妖
novel_title: 七零老太随军，海岛养崽当家做主
content_zh:
赵玉兰心里也有章程，知道什么该说什么不该说。

    像婆婆撇下瘫痪的公公来随迁的事，她是万万不敢嚼舌根的。

    不过这件事带来的冲击相当大。

    魏建业从当兵到驻守荒岛，说是把脑袋别在裤腰带上都不为过。

    说句不好听的，可能某一天人就没了。

    赵玉兰以前揣着心过日子，也打算好真有那么一天只能算命不好。

    守寡是不可能的，先不说夫妻之间感情问题，这婆婆下头还有两个儿子。

    老二不是亲生的也就算了，还有个小叔子呢。

    小的是宝，大的是草，连带老婆孩子都会跟着被当成草，她不能在老魏家耗死。

    不过这次随迁说明老太太的心在大房这，她当大儿媳的也得支棱起来。

    赵玉兰想得热血沸腾，连声催促丈夫赶紧的，婆婆保不齐都已经回家了。

    夫妻俩步履匆匆，瞧见老太太站家门口更是加快了步伐。

    蔡老太走回院子里站定，明显就是有话说。

    夫妻俩亦步亦趋跟上时还对了下眼神，就当是做心理准备。

    片刻后，双方都觉得准备还是少了。

    魏建业不可置信道：“妈，你说你瞅见地上冒水？”

    蔡老太点点头。

    没错儿，小老太的借口就是如此朴实无华，要是起疑或者不信就是渴得还不够！

    她加了一句：“孩子们也见着了。”

    压根就没影的事，但苗苗立刻冲过来，煞有介事地点头。

    小老太咧嘴。

    打从上育红院的龙凤胎回家说老师在他们头顶上开火车以后，她就知道小孩子会胡说八道。

    她又亲自加了一把柴，“估摸着是泉水。”

    魏建业苦着脸说：“应该不是，荒岛全是珊瑚沙，很难出现地下水，现在主岛的水源还是六十多年前有人掘的。

    再往后二十多个小岛饶是再挖出水源，水质也都是又苦又咸，别说人喝了，浇菜都挨嫌。”

    好几十年了，要真有水源哪能发现不了啊。

    或许岛上确实有水源，兴许多年以后技术跟上后能找着也不一定，可一个老同志领着几个小娃娃散散步就发现了，概率不太高啊。

    说是这么说，但魏建业的眼神一直在游离。
content_en:
Zhao Yulan also has rules in her heart and knows what to say and what not to say.

She would never dare to talk about something like her mother-in-law leaving her paralyzed father-in-law to move with her.

However, the impact of this incident was quite large.

From serving as a soldier to stationed on a deserted island, it is no exaggeration to say that Wei Jianye kept his head in his belt.

To put it bluntly, people may disappear one day.

Zhao Yulan used to live her life with her heart in mind, and she also planned that one day she would have to tell bad fortunes.

Being a widow is impossible. Putting aside the emotional problems between husband and wife, this mother-in-law also has two sons.

It doesn’t matter if the second child is not his biological son, he still has a brother-in-law.

The small ones are treasures, the big ones are grass, and the wife and children will also be treated as grass. She cannot be wasted to death in Lao Wei's house.

However, this move shows that the old lady's heart is with the eldest family, and she has to stand up as the eldest daughter-in-law.

Zhao Yulan's blood boiled with thought, and she kept urging her husband to hurry up, but her mother-in-law had already gone home because she couldn't save everything.

The couple walked in a hurry, and even faster when they saw the old lady standing at the door of their house.

Mrs. Cai walked back to the yard and stood there, obviously having something to say.

The couple followed each other step by step and looked at each other, as if they were mentally preparing themselves.

After a while, both sides felt that they were still less prepared.

Wei Jianye said in disbelief: "Mom, you said you saw water coming out of the ground?"

Mrs. Cai nodded.

That's right, the little old lady's excuse is so simple and plain. If you are suspicious or don't believe it, it's because you are not thirsty enough!

She added: "The children have also met."

It didn't matter at all, but Miaomiao rushed over immediately and nodded seriously.

The little old lady grinned.

She knew that children could talk nonsense ever since the twins who went to Yuhongyuan came home and complained that the teacher was driving a train above their heads.

She added a handful of firewood herself, "I guess it's spring water."

Wei Jianye said with a grimace: "Probably not. The desert island is all coral sand, and it is difficult to find underground water. The current water source on the main island was dug more than 60 years ago.

After more than 20 small islands dug out water sources, the water quality was bitter and salty. Not to mention drinking it, even watering vegetables was disgusting."

It has been decades. If there is a real water source, how can we not find it?

Maybe there is indeed a water source on the island, and there is no guarantee that it will be found many years later when technology catches up. But an old comrade took a few children for a walk and discovered it, so the probability is not high.

Although he said this, Wei Jianye's eyes kept wandering.
title_en: Chapter 22 If the child is quiet, he must be acting like a monster
